values: Current BrgySync admin, operations, finance, resident and role-control behavior reflected in the codebase as of November 9, 2026.
A negative test is successful when the invalid action is rejected with a useful message and no unintended write occurs. Mark Execution Status as Pass in that situation.
Use disposable accounts and a dedicated test project or backed-up dataset for deletion, budget, cash, distribution and account-management cases.
Use separate Chrome profiles or one normal and one Incognito window. Two tabs in the same profile share Firebase authentication state.
Record screenshots, reference numbers, timestamps and affected document IDs in Actual Result or Defect ID / Notes.
After mutation tests, verify both the visible UI and Firestore/Realtime Database ledger or metadata specified in Data Integrity Check.
Allow means the action should succeed. Block means validation/security should reject it. Require confirmation means a review dialog is mandatory. Read-only and No change must not create writes.
Run authentication/access tests first, then ordinary request flows, then finance/distribution cases, and destructive deletion cases last.
Re-run all Critical and High priority cases after changes to authentication, status workflow, registry, document vault, budget, cash, distribution or security rules.
